name: ModelVariant128_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant128_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the command's slot parts flash grey and recover, a gradient fills the screen around the slot, 64 random points around the slot grow as one-pixel boxes, and lines through each of up to eight trailing parts sweep across the screen with fading triangle fans. The return value reports the hit (1) once, the end of the boxes (2) or neither (0)); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-145 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant145_entry.c with GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT, VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
